episodes.episode: Book PDF blank-page and publication-state repair
episodes.note: One blank page removed; regenerated publication and checksums.
Two consecutive local repair conversations; not current festival film.
Audio continuity and unwanted generated voice required local reconstruction.
User reverted unwanted cumulative changes; rebuilt separate test requests.

episodes.episode: Memory detail omitted during prompt restructuring
episodes.note: Restoration/checking after user reported details removed.
Investigated failed reference-bound job and continued memory setup.
Compared frames, diagnosed separate early export and spatial offset; repaired test join.
Composer capacity and moderation forced repartition and replacement work.

episodes.episode: Further Face/IP replacements and stale eligibility
episodes.note: Distinct blocked references and replacement binding checks.
Local transition and playback correction; includes attempted solutions.
Rejected reference compared with generated content; diagnosis/reporting.
Restart subsequently completed; exact rejection cause unknown.
Prompt correction and safeguards for P11/P12; no claim that all this interval is rerendering.

episodes.episode: P11 Parliament/Westminster jump and fixed export
episodes.note: Local statue-style repair and end-frame source correction.
Bit-depth/pixel/metadata comparison; gateway causal link remains unproved.

episodes.episode: P00 original-quality, lettering, audio and VLC correction
episodes.note: Revisited downloaded original, local title repair and playback/audio handling.
Creative revision following full-film review; not classified as technical waste.
User-selected experiment later set aside; not all experimentation is failure.
Grady voice preset unavailable; attempted model comparison could not start.
CRF 18 attempt stopped after correction; replaced with source-matched CRF 8. Accepted final encode is outside this error window.
